text:
sylvie: FYI — AcmeCorp called out a month-close mismatch. Dashboard shows 1,203,412 tokens for Sept but invoice line for 'Standard' is 1,263,987 (≈+60.6k). They noticed the totals don't reconcile on the invoice PDF vs the dashboard export. :confused:

morgan: Can you paste the invoice line and the CSV export row sample? we'll need plan IDs and line item ids.

sylvie: attaching quick snippet from invoice PDF (redacted):

```
Invoice # 6443
Account: AcmeCorp
Line: Standard - usage
Period: 2024-09-01 to 2024-09-30
Tokens billed: 1,263,987
```

And a 3-row sample from dashboard CSV export (tokens column is "tokens_used"):

```
account_id,plan,period_start,period_end,tokens_used
acme-1,standard,2024-09-01,2024-09-30,1203412
acme-1,standard,2024-09-01,2024-09-30,0
acme-1,standard,2024-09-01,2024-09-30,0
```

raj: Thanks. Two quick hypotheses: (1) invoice calculation included a late ingestion/backfill after cutoff that got attributed to Sept by ingestion_time, (2) duplicate processing created phantom tokens for that customer in billing pipeline. Can you grep for probe events or backfill runs around 2024-10-01 00:00 UTC? :eyes:

sylvie: Running quick check against raw events (from support-side query). Found a small backfill job finishing just after midnight UTC:

```
# from events_raw
select id, account_id, event_time, ingestion_time, tokens
from events_raw
where account_id = 'acme-1' and event_time >= '2024-09-01' and event_time < '2024-10-01'
order by ingestion_time desc
limit 10;
```

Result (abbreviated):

```
| id    | event_time           | ingestion_time        | tokens |
| 98765 | 2024-09-29T12:03:22Z | 2024-10-01T00:05:12Z  | 12000 |
| 98764 | 2024-09-15T09:18:02Z | 2024-10-01T00:04:58Z  | 48000 |
```

lee: That fits. Dashboard aggregates by event_time (what user saw), but invoice job aggregates by ingestion_time cutoff for sealing the billing window. A late ingestion/backfill will appear on the invoice if ingestion_time >= cutoff window logic. I think billing pipeline used ingestion_time when computing monthly buckets this run.

raj: Can you confirm the billing job's window param for the Sept run? billing-bot, did the monthly-bill job use "bucket_by=ingestion_time" on 2024-10-01?

billing-bot: monthly-bill-run(2024-10-01T00:00:10Z) -> started on billing-prod-2. Config: bucket_by: ingestion_time; cutoff: 2024-10-01T00:00:00Z UTC; backfill_handling: include_if_ingested_before_cutoff=false.

morgan: So invoice used ingestion_time buckets which captured those late ingestions as Sept despite event_time being Sept (dashboard also shows Sept) — wait that would still count to Sept; why are numbers different?

lee: The key is that dashboard export dedupes by event id at display time, but billing pipeline had a subtle race where duplicate replays from the backfill job were processed twice by the aggregator for acme-1 due to at-least-once semantics + missing idempotency key. Two things happened: (a) some events were re-ingested with new ids (so dedupe missed them), (b) a late replay of an already-processed batch retriggered the billing aggregator for that partition and appended tokens again.

sylvie: I pulled aggregator logs for acme-1 partition around 00:04–00:06 UTC:

```
2024-10-01T00:04:59Z INFO aggregator.process partition=acme-1 batch_id=20241001-0048 tokens=48000
2024-10-01T00:05:11Z INFO aggregator.process partition=acme-1 batch_id=20241001-0048 tokens=48000 (replay)
```

raj: That shows a replay applied twice. Not good. We need to run a corrective adjust and patch idempotency. For immediate customer support: offer credit for duplicate tokens and create ticket to recompute invoice lines. Sylvie, can you confirm whether the invoice was already finalized and sent?

sylvie: Invoice was finalized and emailed on 2024-10-01T02:10Z. Customer received PDF.

morgan: Action items: (1) open billing ticket TICK-4572 to recompute AcmeCorp's Sept invoice and issue a corrected invoice/credit, (2) roll a hotfix to aggregator to use a durable idempotency token derived from original event_id, (3) add a monitoring alert for duplicate batch_id replays.

raj: I'll own the hotfix and the recompute. Lee, can you add the alert and verify the ingestion pipeline dedupe?

lee: On it — will create PR for idempotency + alert rule. Reproducer steps I used: run small backfill that replays batch_id X twice against billing-prod replica; check aggregator logs to confirm double-apply. I'll post test vectors.

sylvie: Told AcmeCorp we're investigating and will follow up with a credit/corrected invoice. Keeping them updated. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy-note: billing-aggregator v2.3.1 will be rolled to staging for hotfix validation 2024-10-01T10:00Z.

morgan: Thanks team. Follow-up: please paste the recompute job id once complete and cc finance. Closing on support side once corrected invoice issued.

sylvie: will update TICK-4572 with recompute job id when done.
